run_symbol_database_tests: run the unittest test suite for google.protobuf.symbol_database to verify registration and lookup
test_GetSymbol: test GetSymbol to look up a protobuf message class by its fully qualified name
test_GetPrototype: test GetPrototype to retrieve the message class from a given descriptor
test_GetMessages: test GetMessages to retrieve all registered messages for a given proto file path
test_pool_lookups: test pool lookups like FindMessageTypeByName, FindEnumTypeByName, and FindFileContainingSymbol
